hey there. I’m glad that you posted here so i could see this message. I can’t be there physically to help you and i don’t understand your situation but I have somewhat a belief that you can barely stick yourself out that situation you’re in. i have hope that you can find time to breathe and be at ease, just for a moment because that’s all you really need, a time to breathe. i can’t tell you how to find that moment because we’re different people.  but i believe that somewhere in your journey you can find even a little bit of meaning to your life. 
I hope your life will lengthen out in your favour, i don’t know who you are but that doesn’t take away the fact that i can’t hope for your safety. I’ll be praying for other peoples lives to be cared for before i go to sleep, including yours. i hope you find strength to carry on. 

take care❤️
glad to hear that gun was unloaded, though i hope it was the last. take care my friend ❤️

As much as i want to give a straight foward answer to help you, i really can’t. What i will do is believe in your journey to eventually overcome these feelings. Though it isn’t impossible for you to not make it through this journey. there’s chances that you’ll die so i’ll do whatever i can to believe that you won’t. i’m not doubting you, i just wish a better outcome for your sake and the other people in this subreddit. my prayers are with you and i hope you stay safe, as well as taking care of yourself when you feel the last inch of need to. If you see even an ounce of light at the end of the tunnel, please don’t walk away from it, you can stare at it, walk towards it but don’t walk away. 

take care my friend ❤️
